- The Declaration was adopted by the Continental Congress on July 4, 1776, but the formal signing ceremony took place on August 2, 1776, when the 56 delegates affixed their signatures to the parchment.
- The signers represented all thirteen colonies and were chosen for their prominence, political influence, and commitment to independence.
